findings.text: The company's status is recorded as dissolved, and it ceased on 27 January 2026.
The company was incorporated on 22 August 2024 and was 1.4 years old (523 days) at cessation.
No insolvency record is held for the company.
The register holds the accounts and confirmation statement as of unknown overdue status, with no next due or last made-up dates recorded.
There is one current officer, a director, PERSON 260, appointed on 22 August 2024.
Two individuals, PERSON 261 and PERSON 262, are recorded as persons with significant control, each holding 25 to 50 percent of shares and voting rights.
No charges are registered against the company.
PERSON 260 has one other active appointment, and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
